subject: Re: Kickoff: loss-function guidance for transferable embeddings — status
body:
Hi Anders, Alina,

Status:

- Loading path done Apr 21. We went the TF2 route — running the released SavedModels directly rather than the TF1-compat checkpoint loader — which gives us every block's activations plus final_avg_pool in one forward pass. Background-class drop is handled in the loader as planned.
- Transfer evals: 9 of 12 internal tasks done. The paper's pattern replicates clearly so far — the loss variants with the best source accuracy sit at the bottom of our transfer ranking on 7 of 9 tasks, with penultimate-layer (final_avg_pool) features telling the same story as the block-level probes.

Risk: the 3 remaining tasks are the graph-structured ones, and linear probes may understate transfer there — Ondrej wants to add a small non-linear probe as a check, which adds ~1 week. We can still hold May 29 if we accept linear-only on those three; otherwise Jun 5. Preference?

Rosa
